goalTitle: v41 Controlled CLI Provider Runner + Backend Completion

tasks.title: Controlled runner contract and provider allowlist
acceptance: Controlled provider runner contract defines backend-owned command templates, allowed input fields, output fields, failure states, and safety boundaries.
Active provider ids are exactly claude-code-cli and codex-cli.
Gemini CLI, Kiro CLI, and DeepSeek are not active v41 provider ids.
DeepSeek may appear only as a later sanitized backend profile/ref, not as a runnable provider.
The contract rejects arbitrary shell command input, arbitrary provider ids, arbitrary local paths, secret values, and renderer-owned command construction.
Provider CLI execution is available only through a backend controlled runner.

tasks.title: Backend runner execution adapter
acceptance: Backend runner accepts only allowed provider ids, active goal id, task id, role, reviewed prompt/ref context, and controlled mode.
Command construction happens in backend code, not in UI, fixture input, browser query, or renderer state.
The runner rejects arbitrary command text, shell metacharacter expansion, arbitrary cwd/path, inactive provider ids, and secret-bearing input.
Direct provider execution from UI remains unavailable for claude, codex, Kiro, Gemini, DeepSeek, and shell commands.
Provider execution is bounded by timeout, cwd/workspace policy, env redaction, and failure-layer reporting.

tasks.title: Runner operation registry and sanitized evidence
acceptance: Operation registry records controlled runner lifecycle without treating command success as reviewer approval, main verification, or release readiness.
Registry records provider id, goal id, task id, role, run id, command template id, status, exit code, timing, artifact refs, redaction status, and failure layer.
Evidence refs point to sanitized summaries or artifacts.
Raw provider output, secret-looking values, API keys, OAuth tokens, credential files, and raw provider settings are not exposed.
Failure layer distinguishes schema, provider availability, command execution, timeout, redaction, workspace, and expected-check failures.

tasks.title: Workbench preview and confirm binding
acceptance: Preview returns provider id, active goal/task context, template id, safety fields, expected artifacts, and plan hash.
Confirm accepts only the previewed context plus plan hash.
UI cannot submit arbitrary command, provider binary, cwd, path, prompt text, secret, or inactive provider.
Workbench displays operation status and evidence refs from backend contracts.
Workbench does not infer reviewer approval, main verification, or release readiness from runner output.

tasks.title: Backend completion closeout and controlled real CLI evidence
acceptance: claude-code-cli and codex-cli runner paths are validated through backend-controlled calls or explicit unavailable evidence.
No raw claude, raw codex, Kiro, Gemini, DeepSeek, or arbitrary shell command is used as fallback evidence.
Runner evidence records provider id, task context, operation id, command template id, exit code or blocker, artifact refs, redaction status, and recovery notes.
If real provider CLI execution is required, it runs only through the controlled backend runner.
Release closeout remains gated by the fixture release gates and explicit release-ready event registration.
